scope: Deterministic synthetic component experiments; not real checkpoint fidelity
precision: FP32 operations/IO with explicit FP32 opmath RMS epsilon (1.1920928955078125e-7), BF16-rounded projection constants and rotary tables, FP16 persistent K/V. Original BF16 activation rounding is not emulated.

comparisons.bf16_upstream_vs_candidate: Diagnostic only. No model-fidelity acceptance threshold without independent model outputs.

required_cases: Small dimensions, local and global attention, multi-token prefill and repeated one-token updates
Production dimensions: hidden 1280, query heads 10, KV heads 2, head dimension 128, capacity 2048
Local maximum distance 1024: key zero visible at position 1024 and excluded at 1025
Unused/future cache slots masked; future prefill tokens cannot alter earlier outputs
Fresh request B equals B alone; state A remains independent of B
Post-value-embedding V and post-rotary K stored in cache
Both ordered MUDD paths at production hidden 1280 / inner 32 / taps 3
All outputs finite, shape-correct, and within predeclared component thresholds

resource_gate.meaning: Bounded feasibility screen, not user-facing whole-model performance target
resource_gate.neural_engine: Disabled: CPU_AND_GPU only; actual placement not inferred from configuration

failure_policy: Keep failed results and thresholds; fix implementation errors and label reruns. Any unresolved failures keep their gate partial/failed.
change_reason: Correct implementation epsilon to observed PyTorch 2.7 CPU behavior and inspected PyTorch v2.11 CPU/composite/CUDA source. Initial BF16 dtype epsilon followed an incorrect upstream comment. Numeric thresholds and case requirements are unchanged. Version 1 results retained.
